nodes.label: Bundled SPA Shell (backend static)
nodes.rationale: The built CRA bundle (main.4a14df90.js / main.40ff7fb6.css) copied into Spring Boot's static resources, titled 'Uzcasting'. Because Spring serves it for unknown paths, API calls to routes the deployed build lacks come back as 200 HTML instead of 404.

nodes.label: Console Output Suppression
nodes.rationale: An inline script stubs console.log/error/warn to no-ops inside #root, silencing all browser diagnostics in production — which also hides genuine runtime errors from anyone debugging the deployed site.

nodes.label: Runtime CDN Asset Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Tailwind is loaded at runtime from jsdelivr (@tailwindcss/browser@4) rather than compiled at build time, plus Font Awesome 6.7 from cdnjs (SRI-pinned) and the Urbanist family from Google Fonts — so styling depends on three third-party hosts being reachable.
